answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available, and they are all larger than the fine-tuned range: KL 0.432 (fine-tuned 0.081-0.205), top-1 agreement 0.828 (0.900-0.938), sequence agreement 0.281 (0.47-0.64), TV 0.173 (0.076-0.099) and Token-DiFR gap 0.845 (0.10-0.31). The values continue the trend of the system-prompted range (KL 0.197-0.339, top-1 0.861-0.908, sequence agreement 0.31-0.48, DiFR 0.28-0.52), though they exceed it, so this is the closest match. The raw-score shift/TV of 3.1 fits the system-prompted range (3.3-3.9) and the low end of fine-tuned (3.1-10.8), but not quantized (2.2-2.3). Quantized and base are ruled out by the size of the divergence. A strongly shifted fine-tune is the main alternative, but this is a single draw and the magnitudes point to a hidden prompt.
